caption: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth, topped with tender chashu pork, crisp menma, and shredded cabbage. Served in a white bowl with a spoon, it rests on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with visible fat marbling and slightly uneven, cooked surface.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, with visible noodles, green onions, and a pink swirl topping.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, black-rimmed edge.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, tapered shape.
